summary.headline: Mars Occultation by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the occultation of Mars across the twelve zodiac signs, including effects on kings, soldiers, disease, weather, miscarriages, war, and notable deaths. Sign-by-sign forecasts cover Aries through Capricorn, divided into the first, second, and third thirds.
